blocker_2026_08_10.nearest_asset_is_not_a_substitute: data/olmo2_sft/tulu3_general_* exists on BOTH disks: 234,483 conversations -> 122,070 packed 2048-token sequences on zwfy6 (249,999,360 tokens; 161,118,687 supervised), and a 107,740 x 2048 uint32 clean variant on wzc1. The 107,740 figure is deceptively close to '~100K rows'. It fails every structural requirement: (1) no parent trajectory -- text.jsonl carries {source, prompt, response} where source is a DATASET NAME, giving 9 groups of ~26K rather than ~10K groups of ~10; (2) no step index or decision type, so critical-step selection has no substrate; (3) no success/reward or tool family, both required by section 1; (4) no branch structure, so branch-verified decision credit is undefined; (5) already packed/tokenized with an OLMo-2 tokenizer under a Paper-B-specific 19-pattern deny_sources decontamination filter. Using it would delete the independent variable, not substitute for it.
blocker_2026_08_10.cost_reframe: PROPOSAL.md scopes Phase 0 as 'Data audit, no GPU training'. The real first step is a data-ACQUISITION project: either (a) download an existing agent-trajectory corpus (external, needs proxy hy-proxy.woa.com:3128 + licence check; cheapest, still zero GPU) or (b) generate ~10K rollouts ourselves (large GPU spend PLUS an agent task harness this repo does not have). Neither is the cheap CPU audit the proposal implies.
blocker_2026_08_10.audit_limitation_disclosed: This was a filename/directory search, not a content scan of every file on both disks. Bounded by: both disks searched to depth 4-6, and data/ fully enumerated on both (all entries accounted for as C4 / dolmino / fineweb / redpajama / wikitext / hf_datasets MC benchmarks / tulu3 SFT / instruct-prep scripts). If a pool is later found, correct this record rather than ignoring it -- but the burden is now on producing the path.
